event_comments:
Thank you to all volunteers for helping make this event a success!
Due to a misplaced control (#113) that several people did not find, anyone who otherwise completed the course was given credit for punching that control. We apologize for the frustration. This year we are running a pretty barebones Ultimate Series and, especially for remote events, have difficulty finding vetters. Thanks for your understanding.
